spots.name: WACA Ground
spots.summary: The WACA Ground is a sports stadium in Perth, Western Australia. The stadium's name derives from the initials of its owners and operators, the Western Australian Cricket Association (WACA).

photo.author: The original uploader was Moondyne at English Wikipedia.

spots.name: Curtin University
spots.summary: Curtin University is an Australian public research university based in Bentley, Perth, Western Australia. It is named after John Curtin, Prime Minister of Australia from 1941 to 1945, and is Western Australia's largest university, with 58,607 students in 2022.

spots.name: Subiaco Oval
spots.summary: Subiaco Oval was a sports stadium in Perth, Western Australia, located in the suburb of Subiaco. It was opened in 1908 and closed in 2017 after the completion of the new Perth Stadium in Burswood.

photo.author: Michael Spencer from Perth, WA, Australia

spots.name: Perth Zoo
spots.summary: Perth Zoo is a 17-hectare (41-acre) zoological park in South Perth, Western Australia. The zoo first opened in 1898, and by 2011 housed 1258 animals of 164 species and an extensive botanical collection.

spots.name: Kings Park
spots.summary: Kings Park is a 400.6-hectare (990-acre) park overlooking Perth Water and the Perth central business district, Western Australia.

spots.name: Western Australian Museum
spots.summary: The Western Australian Museum is a statutory authority within the Culture and the Arts Portfolio, established under the Museum Act 1969.

names.zh: 西澳大利亚海洋博物馆

spots.name: Perth Mint
spots.summary: The Perth Mint is Australia's official bullion mint and wholly owned by the Government of Western Australia.

spots.name: St George's Cathedral, Perth

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St George's Cathedral is the principal Anglican church in the city of Perth, Western Australia, and the mother-church of the Anglican Diocese of Perth. It is located on St Georges Terrace in the centre of the city.

spots.name: Grow Your Own
spots.summary: Grow Your Own is a public sculpture situated in Forrest Place, located in the central business district (CBD) of Perth, Western Australia. Created by artist James Angus and unveiled in 2011, the sculpture is notable for its large scale, bright green colour, and abstract form.

spots.name: Art Gallery of Western Australia

hours.note: Closed Tue

spots.summary: The Art Gallery of Western Australia (AGWA) is a public art gallery that is part of the Perth Cultural Centre, in Perth.

names.ja: 西オーストラリア州立美術館

spots.name: Swan Bells

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Swan Bells are a set of 18 bells hanging in a specially built 82.5-metre (271 ft) copper and glass campanile in Perth, Western Australia. The tower is commonly known as the Bell Tower and the Swan Bell Tower.

spots.name: Yagan Square
spots.summary: Yagan Square is a public space and a component of the Perth City Link in Perth, Western Australia. It is situated between the Horseshoe Bridge and the ECU City campus in the eastern part of the Perth City Link precinct, occupying 1.1 hectares. It is named after the Aboriginal warrior Yagan.

spots.name: St Mary's Cathedral, Perth

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St Mary's Cathedral, Perth, officially the Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary, is an Australian cathedral. It is the cathedral church of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Perth and seat of its archbishop, currently Timothy Costelloe.

names.es: Catedral de Santa María de Perth

spots.name: Herdsman Lake
spots.summary: Herdsman Lake is a freshwater lake located on the Swan Coastal Plain in the Perth suburb of Herdsman in Western Australia. It is situated 6 kilometres (3.7 mi) north-west of the Perth central business district.

spots.name: Matagarup Bridge
spots.summary: Matagarup Bridge is a suspension pedestrian bridge crossing over the Swan River in Perth, Western Australia. Situated approximately half-way between Heirisson Island and the Goongoongup Bridge, it provides pedestrian access between Burswood and East Perth.

spots.name: State Library of Western Australia
spots.summary: The State Library of Western Australia (SLWA) is a research, education, reference and public lending library located in the Perth Cultural Centre in Perth, Western Australia.

spots.name: Perth Stadium
spots.summary: Perth Stadium is a stadium located in the Perth suburb of Burswood. It is primarily used for Australian rules football and cricket as the home ground of the West Coast Eagles and the Fremantle Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL) and the Perth Scorchers in the Big Bash League (BBL).

spots.name: Perth Town Hall
spots.summary: The Perth Town Hall, situated on the corner of Hay and Barrack streets in Perth, Western Australia, is the only town hall built by convicts in Australia. Upon completion it was the tallest structure in Perth.

names.ja: パース・タウン・ホール

spots.name: Crown Perth
spots.summary: Crown Perth is a resort and casino located in Burswood, Western Australia, near the Swan River. The resort consists of a casino, a convention centre with meeting rooms, a theatre and two ballrooms along with over thirty restaurants and bars, a nightclub and recreational facilities.

names.ja: バースウッド・エンターテインメント・コンプレックス

spots.name: St Martins Tower

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St Martins Tower is a 140-metre (460 ft) office building in Perth, Western Australia. It was the tallest building in the city from its completion in 1978 for almost 10 years, until it was overtaken in height by the BankWest Tower in 1988.

spots.name: Galup
spots.summary: Galup, formerly Lake Monger is a large urban wetland on the Swan Coastal Plain in suburban Wembley, Western Australia, close to the suburbs of Glendalough, Mount Hawthorn, Leederville and West Leederville.

spots.name: ECU City
spots.summary: ECU City is a university campus of Edith Cowan University located in Perth, Australia. The inner city campus is situated at the Perth City Link, immediately west of Yagan Square. It is located directly on top of the Perth Busport and is near Perth railway station.

spots.name: Karrakatta Cemetery
spots.summary: Karrakatta Cemetery is a metropolitan cemetery in the suburb of Karrakatta in Perth, Western Australia. Karrakatta Cemetery first opened for burials in 1899, the first being that of wheelwright Robert Creighton. Managed by the Metropolitan Cemeteries Board, the cemetery attracts more than one million visitors each year.

spots.name: Narrows Bridge
spots.summary: The Narrows Bridge is a freeway and railway crossing of the Swan River in Perth, Western Australia.

spots.name: EQ West

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: EQ West is a pair of mixed-use skyscrapers under construction at Elizabeth Quay in Perth, Western Australia.

spots.name: General Post Office, Perth
spots.summary: The General Post Office is a heritage landmark building in Perth, Western Australia. Located on the western side of Forrest Place in the city's central business district, its imposing stone facade is in the Beaux-Arts style.

spots.name: Boorloo Bridge
spots.summary: Boorloo Bridge is a pedestrian and cycle crossing comprising two cable-stayed bridges about 250 metres (820 ft) apart that span two separate channels of the Swan River in Perth, Western Australia.

spots.name: Government House, Perth
spots.summary: Government House is the official residence of the governor of Western Australia, situated in the central business district of Perth, the state capital. It was built between 1859 and 1864, in the Jacobean Revival style.

spots.name: 140 St Georges Terrace

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: 140 St Georges Terrace is a 30-storey skyscraper in Perth, Western Australia. Opened in 1975, the 131-metre (430 ft) tower was known as the AMP Building or AMP Tower after its former owner and flagship tenant, AMP Limited.

spots.name: Exchange Plaza

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Exchange Tower, formerly Exchange Plaza, is a 40-storey skyscraper in Perth, Western Australia. Completed in 1992, the 146-metre (479 ft), it is the seventh tallest skyscraper in Perth.

spots.name: 100 St Georges Terrace

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: 100 St Georges Terrace is a 24-storey skyscraper located at 100 St Georges Terrace in Perth, Western Australia. It is a mixed retail and commercial property. The retail component, named enex perth, is made up of two floors of shops and food outlets between St Georges Terrace and the Hay Street Mall.

spots.name: Horseshoe Bridge
spots.summary: The Horseshoe Bridge in Perth, Western Australia is a traffic bridge that connects the Perth CBD to Northbridge, carrying William Street. It was constructed in 1904 to pass over the Fremantle railway line, with the horseshoe shape designed to fit the approach ramps into a constricted site.

spots.name: Allendale Square

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Allendale Square is a 32-storey skyscraper in Perth, Western Australia. When opened in 1976, the 132-metre (433 ft) building surpassed the AMP Building to become the tallest completed building in Perth, a title which it only held until 1977 when St Martins Tower opened.

spots.name: Spanda
spots.summary: Spanda is a public art work by Australian born artist Christian de Vietri located at Elizabeth Quay in Perth, Western Australia. It was installed in January 2016. The sculpture is elegant, abstract, and minimalist, giving the impression of an ever-expanding vibrational pattern.

spots.name: Perth Institute of Contemporary Arts

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: Perth Institute of Contemporary Arts (PICA) is a contemporary visual and performance arts venue located in a heritage-listed building in Perth, Western Australia.

spots.name: Mercedes College
spots.summary: Mercedes College is an independent Roman Catholic single-sex secondary day school for girls, located in the Perth central business district, Western Australia.

spots.name: Jacob's Ladder
spots.summary: Jacob's Ladder is an outdoor stairway in Perth, Western Australia. Consisting of 242 concrete steps, the stairway links the north-east corner of King's Park with the Swan River, though it is not part of Kings Park itself.

spots.name: QV1

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: QV1 is a 40-storey modernist skyscraper in Perth, Western Australia. Completed in 1991, the 163-metre (535 ft) building is the fourth-tallest building in Perth, after Central Park, Brookfield Place and 108 St Georges Terrace.

spots.name: State Theatre Centre of Western Australia
spots.summary: The State Theatre Centre of Western Australia is a theatre complex located within the Perth Cultural Centre in Perth, Western Australia. The larger of three dedicated performance areas is known as the Heath Ledger Theatre in honour of Perth-born film actor Heath Ledger.
spots.wikipediaTitle: State Theatre Centre of Western Australia

spots.name: Parliament House
spots.summary: Parliament House is located on Harvest Terrace in West Perth, Western Australia. It is the home of the Parliament of Western Australia, including the Legislative Council and Legislative Assembly.

spots.name: Treasury Buildings, Perth
spots.summary: The Treasury Buildings, or Old Treasury Buildings, are part of the Cathedral Square complex situated between Barrack Street and St Georges Terrace in Perth, Western Australia.

spots.name: Wesley Church, Perth

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Wesley Church is a Uniting Church in Perth, Western Australia, located at the corner of William Street and Hay Street. It is one of the oldest church buildings and one of few remaining 19th-century colonial buildings in the City of Perth.

spots.name: Stirling Gardens
spots.summary: Stirling Gardens is a small public park in Perth, Western Australia.

spots.name: St John's Pro-Cathedral

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St John's Pro-Cathedral is located at 18 Victoria Avenue in Perth, Western Australia. It is the earliest Roman Catholic church building in Western Australia.

spots.name: Lawson Apartments
spots.summary: Lawson Apartments are located at 2–4 Sherwood Court near the corner with The Esplanade, in Perth, Western Australia. They are situated across the road from the Elizabeth Quay precinct and adjacent to the Weld Club.

spots.name: Scitech

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Scitech is a not-for-profit company encompassing the Scitech Discovery Centre, an interactive science centre in West Perth, Western Australia, outreach programs, professional learning programs and digital content.

spots.name: Rechabite Hall
spots.summary: Rechabite Hall is a heritage-listed building in Perth, Western Australia, located at 224 William Street. It has operated as The Rechabite since 2019. It was constructed in 1924 for the Independent Order of Rechabites – a friendly society and part of the temperance movement – and was a popular dance hall in the 1920s.

spots.name: Hackett Hall
spots.summary: Hackett Hall is a heritage listed building, previously housing part of the State Library of Western Australia. It is now a part of the new Western Australian Museum complex in the Perth Cultural Centre, in Western Australia.

spots.name: Perth Rectangular Stadium
spots.summary: Perth Rectangular Stadium is a stadium located near the Perth central business district. It is primarily used for soccer and rugby union as the home ground of Perth Glory FC in the A-League Men and the Western Force in the Super Rugby Pacific.

spots.name: Bayswater Subway
spots.summary: The Bayswater Subway was a road under rail subway in Perth, Western Australia. It was located immediately west of Bayswater railway station, and carried King William Street / Coode Street beneath the Midland line. The subway was demolished in April 2023 as part of Metronet's rebuild of Bayswater station.

spots.name: Royal Hotel

hours.note: Closed Mon, Fri, Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Royal Hotel is a hotel building in Perth, Western Australia on the corner of Wellington and William streets. It was built in 1882.

spots.name: Perth Arena
spots.summary: Perth Arena is an entertainment and sporting arena in the city centre of Perth, Western Australia, used mostly for basketball games. It is located on Wellington Street near the site of the former Perth Entertainment Centre, and was officially opened on 10 November 2012.

spots.name: Wireless Hill Park
spots.summary: Wireless Hill Park is a 40-hectare (99-acre) park in Ardross, Western Australia that is the location of the former Applecross Wireless Station, an early radio station in Western Australia. The station buildings have been preserved and now house the Wireless Hill Museum.

spots.name: The Nostalgia Box

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Nostalgia Box is a video game museum located in Perth, Western Australia. It is the first interactive video game console museum in Australia. Founded by Jessie Yeoh, it was purchased by David Green in 2019.

spots.name: Commonwealth Bank Building
spots.summary: The Commonwealth Bank Building is a heritage building in Perth, Western Australia, on the western side of Forrest Place in the city's central business district.

spots.name: Mount Henry Bridge
spots.summary: The Mount Henry Bridge is a pair of parallel bridges which carry the Kwinana Freeway and Mandurah line across the Canning River in Perth, Western Australia. At 660 metres (2,170 ft) long, the Mount Henry Bridge is the longest bridge in Western Australia.

spots.name: City of Perth Library

hours.note: Closed Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The City of Perth Library is a public library service provided by the City of Perth. The library is located on Hay Street, next to the Perth Town Hall. It is part of the redevelopment of Cathedral Square, located between St Georges Terrace and Hay, Barrack and Pier Streets.

spots.name: Barracks Arch
spots.summary: The Barracks Arch is located on the corner of Malcolm and Elder Streets, at the western end of St Georges Terrace in Perth, Western Australia.

spots.name: Old Perth Technical School
spots.summary: The 1910 Perth Technical School building is located at 137 St Georges Terrace, Perth, Western Australia, adjacent to the Old Perth Boys School building, which had served as part of the school's former temporary premises since opening of classes there on 16 May 1900.

spots.name: Trinity Church, Perth

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Trinity Church is a Uniting church located at 72 St Georges Terrace in Perth, Western Australia. Commenced in 1893, the former Congregational church is one of the oldest church buildings in the City of Perth, and one of the few remaining 19th-century colonial buildings in the city.

spots.name: Chinatown
spots.summary: Perth's little Chinatown, with its own Chinese gate, is a good spot for picking up Asian groceries and also the best place for late night dining in Perth. Most venues are BYO. Chinese businesses in Northbridge are not confined to Chinatown but can be found throughout Northbridge, and most visibly along William St.

The towering liquor cabinets are almost two stories high and as one might imagine, the draft beer, cocktail and "shooter" list is equ

spots.name: Metro City

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: It hosts a weekly R&B/hip hop night but this enormous venue also hosts concerts and large dance music events. When heading into Perth by train from the west, Metro's is clearly visible from the window as its unique, palace-like exterior stands out amongst the multi-level carparks and other bland buildings which can be seen along Roe St.

spots.name: The Moon Cafe

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A staple for university students, gays and coffee-house intellectuals. It has off beat interior design, an assortment of quirky lamps, retro lounges and board games. Hosts a Jazz band every Thursday. Also serves great alcoholic beverages, light meals and snacks.

spots.name: Picabar

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Attached to the Perth Institute of Contemporary Arts, this venue has dibs on an extremely central and pleasant location in Perth's cultural centre. In summertime you can sit outside and watch the big screen.

spots.name: The William Street Bird

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A major Perth venue for local and international acts of impeccable quality. Very reasonable drink prices on non-peak nights and intimate outdoor area with city views.

spots.name: Ambar

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: This unpretentious bar/club serves some very tasty cocktails to complement its uber-cool music policy. The crowd has a friendly and "up for it" attitude.

spots.name: Lucky Shag Bar

hours.note: Closed Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

spots.summary: Bar and restaurant with a focus on breakfast. Located right on the river with great views. Also has live music and a great beer selection.

spots.name: C Restaurant Lounge

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Has amazing views of the entire city including Kings Park. The food is good but the view is most definitely the defining feature.

spots.name: Magnet House

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Probably the most popular nightclub in Perth. Magnet House is full every weekend - usually plays quite mainstream music.

spots.name: Belgian Beer Cafe Westende
spots.summary: Has an impressive selection of imported and local beers on tap, with specialised glassware to match.

spots.summary: Extremely cheap Japanese food.
